name: Vincent Denis
bio:
Vincent Denis is a highly skilled tattoo artist specialized in illustrative styles, tattooing in Strasbourg, France. With a massive Instagram community of around 97,000 followers, his artistic brilliance and creativity are clearly recognized and admired globally. He maintains a high level of professionalism in his work, with an emphasis on communication through emails for bookings. His work speaks volumes about his dedication and attention to detail in delivering fine quality tattoos to his clients.
